flashcard_questions.q: A condition affecting the airways that causes them to narrow, swell and produce extra mucus, making breathing difficult.
A lifelong condition where the body cannot properly regulate blood sugar levels.
A neurological disorder affecting the central nervous system that causes seizures.

flashcard_questions.a: A blue inhaler used during an asthma attack to quickly open the airways and relieve symptoms.
A brown or purple inhaler taken daily to reduce airway inflammation and prevent asthma attacks.
